newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes 19 cents up on London's gains.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes 19 cents up on London's gains.

text.p: Tin price in Malaysia closed 19 cents higher at 14.75 ringgit ($5.93) a kg after a firmer London market triggered overseas buying, traders said.
"The market was firm and followed the London trend," a trader said, adding buying came mainly from Europe, Malaysia and Japan. Turnover rose to 201 tonnes against 125 on Tuesday.
The near-term trend depends largely on the performance of the London market, traders said.
The local price differential to London widened to $55 a tonne premium after holding a discount of $25 on Tuesday.
